nodes.description: The cache-hit path passes the cached entry itself to xmlCopyNode, so the sink dereference operates on that cached pointer.

edges.description: The live text node allocated in xmlXIncludeLoadTxt is stored into ctxt->txtTab.
Reader cleanup frees the same node pointer before a later cache hit reuses it in xmlCopyNode.

root_cause_criterion.description: At cache insertion, the stored cache value must be detached from the transient reader-owned text node content instead of aliasing that node's content source.
